title: A Photograph From Where Nobody Stood

scenes.subtext: From the empty side of the counter.
scenes.narration: A photograph was handed in tonight. It is of me, behind this counter, in the shirt I am wearing now.
scenes.imagePrompt: A square instant photograph lying face up on a wooden counter beside a brass bell, the image too dim to make out, no people, photographed on grainy 35mm film under a single bare tungsten bulb, the whole frame colour-graded warm amber like sodium light with no grey or blue cast, heavy analog grain

scenes.narration: It is taken from the visitor's side of the counter. Nobody has stood on that side all evening.
scenes.imagePrompt: The visitor side of a lost property counter in a basement, an empty patch of worn linoleum in front of it, a single bulb above, no people, photographed on grainy 35mm film under a single bare tungsten bulb, the whole frame colour-graded warm amber like sodium light with no grey or blue cast, heavy analog grain

scenes.text: THE NEW SHELF IS BEHIND ME
scenes.narration: Behind me in the photograph is the new shelf. The empty one, the one as long as I am tall.
scenes.imagePrompt: A dim photograph of a person in a grey cardigan behind a counter, a wire mesh cage behind them, figure soft and out of focus, no face visible, photographed on grainy 35mm film under a single bare tungsten bulb, the whole frame colour-graded warm amber like sodium light with no grey or blue cast, heavy analog grain

scenes.narration: In the photograph it is not empty. Somebody is lying on it, very still, with a tag tied around one wrist.
scenes.imagePrompt: Inside a dark wire mesh cage, a figure lying very still on a long steel shelf, a brown luggage tag hanging from one wrist, the face turned to the wall, no face visible, photographed on grainy 35mm film under a single bare tungsten bulb, the whole frame colour-graded warm amber like sodium light with no grey or blue cast, heavy analog grain
